title: Granted US patent, cited 27 times
summary: The US patent office granted my patent on determining user availability; it has since been cited by 27 other patents.
the_call: Pursue the invention through filing, publication and grant.
what_i_did: Invented the method and saw it through from disclosure to grant.
what_changed: Granted as US 8,560,487, with 27 patent citations and 8 non-patent citations.
